_meta.register: Authored to the printed voice (conventions read, 2026-08-03): substances are effect-adjective + state-of-matter noun, one to three words, article-free, never clauses ('sleep gas', 'scalding steam', 'repulsion energy' — never 'moss-sheathed root and stone'). Crafted attack names are two words, [element/material/condition] + [weapon] ('Flame Whip', 'Frost Axe', 'Grave Strike'). Delivery verbs are the small printed set, agreeing with the substance's state of matter. Damage affinities are MEASURED counts from the 329-block corpus and stay weights, never filters.

fields.substances: fills for {substance}: what a breath, burst, aura, or dissolution is made of
fields.appendages: fills for {appendage}/{appendage_plural}: one/many pairs, concrete limbs or implements
fields.name_adjectives: leading words for ability and creature names in this register
fields.name_nouns: concrete head nouns (agents, forms, implements) for names in this register
fields.damage_affinity: measured printed counts of energy damage for the facet's home type; thin samples marked
fields.vet_tokens: SMALL, high-confidence domain-claiming tokens for the Phase 3 fill vet — a fill containing one is claiming this facet. Must stay unique across facets; ambiguous words (molten, ash, mist) deliberately excluded.

_meta.houses_note: A HOUSE is one material and the vocabulary it earns — finer than a facet, which spans several (elemental holds magma, stone, storm, ice and sand at once). The engine declares ONE house per block, scored from the concept prose, and every material fill and name draws from it: brine and sleet are both Cold-legal and both wrong together (owner call 2026-08-05). Token lists cover the words CONCEPTS use, not just the house's own name: 'salt-toughened plant fiber' matched nothing and fell through to a blind seeded pick that chose chitin for a plant creature (live: the Graspwarden, 2026-08-05).
